boundaries.GPU_resources: No resource requested or used; n08..11 current owner and protected jobs untouched
boundaries.metric: B1 useful committed decode tokens per second after prefill/anchor; include draft wait, target verification, replay/commit and EOS decision; not prefill or aggregate large-batch throughput
boundaries.quality: Complete final generated token sequence including first EOS must match same-prompt ordinary AR; intermediate BF16 tensor bit identity is diagnostic, not the user's acceptance criterion

verdict: Actual Modal trained-draft B1 W8/W16 ran on GPU and was slower than paired AR. Whole 16-case wave FAILED; eight complete ID/EOS-matching cases are partial negative evidence only. No qualified trained online speculative speedup exists in reviewed evidence. Do not rerun fixed4 or a longer draft as a new optimization.

measured_online.independent_audit: r4881 crosschecked all four node generated full IDs/EOS and 514 request/reply token lists, cached prefixes and feature-body SHAs. Target owners closed normally; this does not repair failed whole-wave qualification.
measured_online.failure: Third prompt has 515 actual tokens; worker r4859 asserts count<=512 and exits, target EOF/ConnectionReset. Boundary repair was already separately tested r4896; repeating it is not new progress.
measured_online.width_semantics: Historical W8 means anchor+7 draft proposals, W16 means anchor+15. User's literal draft length 8/16 would require W9/W17. Do not label existing K7/K15 data as measured 8/16 additional draft tokens.
measured_online.timing_limits: Mean rates are repeat means; component seconds are r0 examples. CAPI wall includes native compute/comm/sync, not pure GPU kernel time. Draft worker compute overlaps caller wait; do not add twice. CPU full-vocabulary validation/D2H/barriers were included. Best ordinary rate from another source/run is not a causal paired comparison.

implementation.binding: r4860 ctypes binds modern_kimi_engine_spec_r3632 from SHA-pinned r4830 libmodern_kimi_fast_tap_r4830.so; create_spec requires TP8PP4. Original staged shim sets sample_all_positions=true and supplies nonalias active/shadow SSM read/write indices.
implementation.all_final_tokens_verified: Yes, each proposal accepted only while D[m]==target_output[m]; emit that accepted prefix plus target correction out[m], truncate at first EOS. All target logits sampled per position from the initial one-block call, not K+1 complete Engine.forward calls.
implementation.actual_CAPI_counts: natural0 K7 has 73 verification calls (69 width8 plus short tails), and 72 additional replay calls. K15 has 73 verification calls (62 width16 plus tails), and 72 replay calls.
implementation.recovery: Target verify writes shadow recurrent state. On rejection, rerun anchor+accepted proposal prefix of length m+1 from untouched active state into shadow, overwriting speculative KV suffix as needed, then swap active/shadow and increment past by m+1. The emitted correction is the next round's unconsumed anchor. Draft worker DynamicCache crops to accepted feature prefix before next call. Terminal EOS/limit may skip replay because there is no continuation.
implementation.limitation: No ready replay-free per-prefix recurrent snapshots or alternative topology spec create binding established; cannot merely set a flag to remove replay.

first_result_estimate.formula: 33.77+4*(104-33.77)=314.68. Replicates all prior non-CPU-read cost4times despite prior8arms/current4arms. Inference only, not empirical bound; fresh node/data locality unknown. Cannot promise5min; hard10min lease/540s timeout mandatory.

primary_card.success: Material trace-free whole-MoE speedup beyond ABBA noise; no nonfinite/router mismatch. Intermediate FFN differences retained for downstream finaltoken gate rather than auto-rejected solely by bits.
